meta.name: publication
meta.description: Pub-grade default for the V3 scene chassis (tier figures). Inherits cell_press, then refines the content-channel keys that reach tier molecules / blobs / text for print-grade figure-ground contrast: deeper CPK heteroatoms (amber S / orange P were too pale on a light band), crisp near-black bonds + FG labels, and a lighter-fill / darker-stroke protein blob so a residue sitting in the cavity stays legible. Edge colour semantics (hbond blue / dashed gray / curly auburn / inhibits red) live in the tier engine's _EDGE_DEFAULTS, not here.
